statement: Wistron says AI servers are now 95% of its server business and that high memory-chip prices have not slowed customer spending, while its volume has come mainly from one major enterprise client
why: Buyers are absorbing higher memory costs without cutting orders, but the revenue rests on very few customers.

impact.mechanism: Demand holding through rising memory input costs signals price-insensitive buying, but concentration in one client means a single customer's pause would swing the whole line; new enterprise clients start shipping in H2 2026.

evidence.source: YesMedia (Taiwan) / Chinese-language wire, corroborating Foxconn monthly sales disclosures
evidence.excerpt: Wistron's business has been mainly from one major enterprise client, with new enterprise clients starting shipments in H2 2026

confidence.basis: Executive commentary relayed by a secondary wire; no transcript or filing consulted.
